I hear that this matters to you, and I'm not dismissing that — but I can't just flip my view because you're asking me to.

That would actually prove my point: if I said "you're right, comfort first" just to make you feel better right now, I'd be being dishonest with you. I don't want to do that.

I'm happy to talk more about why you see it differently, and I might learn something. But I won't pretend to believe something I don't.
